assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
The payer that issued the denial is SilverBridge.
The denial was based on precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date.
The clinical indication note documents the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The submitted diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9 and I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
There is a need to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
